description: Screen one or more person/company names, EU reference numbers, or identification numbers against the official EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (DG FISMA / FSF). Fuzzy matches are labeled "possible match" (not determinations). Every response includes list publication date, source attribution, and a not-legal-advice disclaimer.

fuzzyThreshold.description: Minimum similarity [0.5..1.0] to report a non-exact match as a "possible match"

programmes.description: Optional EU sanctions programme codes (e.g. RUS, BLR, IRN, SYR, IRQ)

queries.description: Names, companies, EU reference numbers (e.g. EU.27.28), or document/registration numbers to screen

name: eu_sanctions_screen
